scripts.deploy:personal: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-personal-deploy.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/milestone1-unit.test.mjs tests/milestone2-unit.test.mjs tests/milestone3-unit.test.mjs tests/milestone4-unit.test.mjs tests/milestone5-unit.test.mjs tests/shared-contracts.test.mjs tests/phase1-foundation.test.mjs tests/phase2-ingestion.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node --test tests/milestone1-integration.test.mjs tests/milestone1-isolation.test.mjs tests/milestone2-integration.test.mjs tests/milestone3-integration.test.mjs tests/milestone4-integration.test.mjs tests/milestone5-integration.test.mjs tests/phase2-integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test tests/milestone1-e2e.test.mjs tests/milestone1-http-e2e.test.mjs tests/milestone2-http-e2e.test.mjs tests/milestone3-http-e2e.test.mjs tests/milestone4-http-e2e.test.mjs tests/milestone5-http-e2e.test.mjs tests/mobile-http-e2e.test.mjs tests/phase2-http-e2e.test.mjs

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
